title: Operating Systems
subject: operating-systems
description: Operating Systems MCQs on process scheduling, deadlocks, memory management, and paging for C-CAT. Essential revision material for C-CAT aspirants.

questions.question: What is the formula for Turnaround Time?
questions.explanation: Turnaround Time = Completion Time - Arrival Time. It measures total time from arrival to completion.

questions.question: Which CPU scheduling algorithm can cause starvation of long processes?
What does the PCB (Process Control Block) primarily enable?
questions.explanation: The PCB stores all process information needed for context switching between processes.

questions.question: How many of the 4 Coffman conditions must hold for a deadlock to occur?
questions.explanation: All four Coffman conditions (Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait) must hold for deadlock.

questions.question: The Banker's Algorithm is used for which deadlock-handling strategy?
questions.explanation: All four Coffman conditions (Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait) must hold for deadlock.

questions.question: Belady's Anomaly (more frames causing more page faults) occurs with which algorithm?
questions.explanation: Belady's Anomaly occurs with FIFO page replacement, where more frames can paradoxically cause more page faults.

questions.question: Paging can lead to which type of fragmentation?
questions.explanation: Paging causes internal fragmentation because the last page may be only partially filled.

questions.question: What primarily causes thrashing?
options: Too many processes competing for too little physical memory
questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when too many processes compete for too little physical memory, causing excessive page faults.
